covenants.name: Tangible Net Worth
covenants.quote: Maintain at all times Tangible Net Worth of not less than $20,000,000.

covenants.name: Liquidity
covenants.quote: Maintain at all times Liquidity of not less than $10,000,000.

covenants.name: Debt-to-Tangible Net Worth Ratio
covenants.quote: Maintain at all times a Debt to Tangible Net Worth Ratio of not more than 12:1.

covenants.name: Adjusted Net Income
covenants.quote: Maintain, as of the end of each calendar month, for the twelve months then ending, Adjusted Net Income of not less than $1.00.

parsed.notes: Mortgage warehouse facility for the mortgage-lending subsidiary of M/I Homes, Inc. There is no EBITDA definition; covenants are balance-sheet based. Tangible Net Worth, Liquidity and Debt-to-TNW are tested at all times (not just quarter-end); Adjusted Net Income is tested monthly on a trailing-twelve-month basis and must simply be positive ($1.00). Debt-to-TNW uses Adjusted Total Liabilities (includes off-balance-sheet warehouse lines not provided by end purchasers, less Subordinated Debt and non-guarantor sub liabilities) over TNW. TNW excludes intangibles and MSRs, but adds back MSRs at the lesser of book value, a third-party valuation, or 0.75% of the serviced portfolio UPB, and it gives the Agent discretion to treat other assets as intangible. Liquidity is unencumbered cash plus unused availability under this facility, plus up to $1.5M of unused availability under other warehouse lines. A breach of Section 5.9 is an immediate Event of Default under Section 7.1(c), with no grace period and no cure right. Change of control occurs if M/I Homes ceases to own 100% of the Borrower. If there are fewer than three Lenders, Majority Lenders means all Lenders. There are no unrestricted subsidiary concepts. As of closing the Borrower is the only Credit Party; subsidiary guarantors are only added at the Borrower's election. Advances are limited by a borrowing base with advance rates of 98% for conforming loans and 97% for jumbo loans, plus wet-funded sublimits.
parsed.facility: Revolving mortgage warehouse line of $200M (seasonal step-ups to $275M from Sep 18 to Nov 10 and to $300M from Nov 11 to Feb 9), with a $50M swing line, maturing May 24, 2024.

terms.summary: The agreement has no unrestricted subsidiary concept and no restriction aimed specifically at transferring or licensing material intellectual property.

Affected-lender consent rights cover commitment increases, reductions or postponements of payments, collateral and guaranty releases, and certain definitions. Subordination of the loans or liens is not among them. The Agent may also subordinate its liens to purchase-money liens permitted under Section 6.2(b).

terms.quote: if all of the Equity Interests held by the Credit Parties in any Person are sold or otherwise transferred to any transferee other than Borrower or a Subsidiary of Borrower as part of or in connection with any disposition (whether by sale, by merger or by any other form of transaction) permitted in accordance with the terms of this Agreement, to release such Person from all of its obligations under the Loan Documents (including, without limitation, under any Subsidiary Guaranty)
terms.summary: A guarantor is automatically released only when all of the Credit Parties' equity in it is sold to a third party, so becoming non-wholly owned does not by itself trigger release. There is no express Chewy-style provision, and no subsidiary guarantors exist at closing.
There is no unrestricted subsidiary designation mechanism, so no cap. Investments are limited by Section 6.7 baskets, including a $5M general basket, but investments in Subsidiaries are uncapped.
There is no EBITDA definition and no add-backs for cost savings, synergies or restructuring.
The agreement has no equity cure right; a financial covenant breach is an immediate Event of Default.
